nodes.name: When Called By Agent
nodes.notes: Agent contract: Envelope v1.0. Called by WF-04 for QUALIFIED leads.

nodes.name: Fetch Lead + Grounded Candidates

parameters.query:
WITH lead AS (
  SELECT l.lead_id, l.business_id, l.trace_id, e.contact_name, e.company,
         e.budget_value, e.budget_currency, e.product_interest, e.urgency, e.location, q.band,
         (SELECT min(price) FROM vaibhavcapstone_products mp
          WHERE mp.business_id = l.business_id AND mp.stock_qty > 0) AS min_price
  FROM vaibhavcapstone_leads l
  JOIN vaibhavcapstone_extractions e USING (lead_id)
  JOIN vaibhavcapstone_qualifications q USING (lead_id)
  WHERE l.lead_id = $1 AND l.status = 'QUALIFIED'),
toks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(w) AS tok FROM lead,
    jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(lead.product_interest, '[]'::jsonb)) t(v),
    regexp_split_to_table(t.v, '[-_\s]+') w WHERE length(w) > 2),
cands AS (
  SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.currency, p.stock_qty, p.attributes
  FROM vaibhavcapstone_products p, lead
  WHERE p.business_id = lead.business_id AND p.stock_qty > 0
    AND (lead.budget_value IS NULL OR p.price <= lead.budget_value * 1.15
         OR (lead.budget_value > 100000))  -- bulk/total budgets: do not price-cap items
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM toks WHERE p.category ILIKE '%' || regexp_replace(toks.tok, 's$', '') || '%'
                                      OR p.name ILIKE '%' || regexp_replace(toks.tok, 's$', '') || '%')
  ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 12)
SELECT lead.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM vaibhavcapstone_products cp WHERE cp.business_id = lead.business_id) AS catalog_size, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(c) FROM cands c), '[]'::jsonb) AS candidates FROM lead;

nodes.notes: GROUNDING SOURCE: in-stock products of THIS business, filtered by interest tokens + budget window. The LLM never sees products it may not pick.

nodes.name: Verify SKUs + Persist

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::text lead, $2::text biz, $3::text trc, $4::jsonb items),
cand AS (SELECT i->>'sku' AS sku, i->>'rationale' AS rat, ord.n
  FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(p.items) WITH ORDINALITY ord(i, n)),
ok AS (SELECT c.sku, c.rat, c.n, pr.name, pr.price, pr.currency FROM cand c
  JOIN vaibhavcapstone_products pr ON pr.business_id = (SELECT biz FROM p)
   AND pr.sku = c.sku AND pr.stock_qty > 0),
agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sku', sku, 'name', name, 'price', price,
  'currency', currency, 'rationale', rat) ORDER BY n), '[]'::jsonb) AS items, count(*) AS cnt FROM ok),
ins AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_recommendations (lead_id, business_id, items, grounded, no_grounded_reason)
  SELECT p.lead, p.biz, agg.items, agg.cnt > 0,
         CASE WHEN agg.cnt = 0 THEN 'model items failed SQL verification' END FROM p, agg
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO UPDATE SET items = EXCLUDED.items, grounded = EXCLUDED.grounded,
    no_grounded_reason = EXCLUDED.no_grounded_reason RETURNING grounded),
upd AS (UPDATE vaibhavcapstone_leads SET
  status = CASE WHEN (SELECT grounded FROM ins) THEN 'RECOMMENDED' ELSE 'NEEDS_REVIEW' END,
  status_detail = CASE WHEN (SELECT grounded FROM ins) THEN status_detail
    ELSE jsonb_build_object('reason', 'no_grounded_option', 'detail', 'model items failed SQL verification', 'resume_from', 'recommend') END,
  updated_at = now() WHERE lead_id = (SELECT lead FROM p) AND status = 'QUALIFIED' RETURNING status),
ev AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_events (business_id, lead_id, trace_id, agent, action, actor, detail)
  SELECT p.biz, p.lead, p.trc, 'recommender',
    CASE WHEN (SELECT grounded FROM ins) THEN 'RECOMMENDATION_GROUNDED' ELSE 'RECOMMENDATION_NO_GROUNDED' END,
    'system', jsonb_build_object('items', (SELECT items FROM agg), 'verified_count', (SELECT cnt FROM agg))
  FROM p RETURNING event_id)
SELECT (SELECT grounded FROM ins) AS grounded, (SELECT items FROM agg) AS items, (SELECT lead FROM p) AS lead_id;

nodes.notes: Second guardrail layer: SQL re-joins every item to a live in-stock product row. Zero survivors -> NEEDS_REVIEW, never a made-up recommendation.

nodes.name: Persist No-Grounded-Option

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::text lead, $2::text biz, $3::text trc, $4::text reason),
ins AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_recommendations (lead_id, business_id, items, grounded, no_grounded_reason)
  SELECT lead, biz, '[]'::jsonb, false, reason FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO UPDATE SET items = '[]'::jsonb, grounded = false,
    no_grounded_reason = EXCLUDED.no_grounded_reason RETURNING lead_id),
drf AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_drafts (draft_id, lead_id, business_id, draft_type, subject, body, status)
  SELECT 'drf_' || substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 14), lead, biz, 'INTERNAL',
         'No grounded recommendation for this lead',
         'The recommender found no verifiable in-stock catalog match. Reason: ' || reason ||
         '. Suggested actions: check upcoming stock, offer an alternative category, or reply manually.', 'DRAFT'
  FROM p RETURNING draft_id),
upd AS (UPDATE vaibhavcapstone_leads SET status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW',
  status_detail = jsonb_build_object('reason', 'no_grounded_option', 'detail', (SELECT reason FROM p), 'resume_from', 'recommend'),
  updated_at = now() WHERE lead_id = (SELECT lead FROM p) AND status = 'QUALIFIED' RETURNING status),
ev AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_events (business_id, lead_id, trace_id, agent, action, actor, detail)
  SELECT biz, lead, trc, 'recommender', 'RECOMMENDATION_NO_GROUNDED', 'system',
    jsonb_build_object('reason', reason, 'internal_draft', (SELECT draft_id FROM drf)) FROM p RETURNING event_id)
SELECT false AS grounded, (SELECT reason FROM p) AS reason;

nodes.notes: Honesty path (E5-S2): records why, files an INTERNAL note draft for the rep, parks lead in NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.name: Park AWAITING_SETUP (no catalog)

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::text lead, $2::text biz, $3::text trc),
u AS (UPDATE vaibhavcapstone_leads SET status = 'AWAITING_SETUP',
  status_detail = jsonb_build_object('reason', 'setup_incomplete', 'missing', jsonb_build_array('catalog'),
    'resume_from', 'recommend', 'parked_at', now()), updated_at = now()
  WHERE lead_id = (SELECT lead FROM p) RETURNING lead_id),
ev AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_events (business_id, lead_id, trace_id, agent, action, actor, detail)
  SELECT biz, lead, trc, 'recommend', 'LEAD_PARKED_AWAITING_SETUP', 'system',
    jsonb_build_object('missing', 'catalog') FROM p RETURNING event_id)
SELECT (SELECT lead FROM p) AS lead_id, 'AWAITING_SETUP' AS status;

nodes.notes: PRODUCT STATE, not an error: the tenant has no catalog yet. Lead keeps everything learned so far and resumes automatically when upload_catalog runs.

nodes.notes: Merge point: normalizes Gemini or OpenAI responses to one shape; __model/__fallback feed telemetry.

parameters.content:
## Choosing what to actually offer

This is where the system recommends products — and where it would be easiest to embarrass the business by inventing something that doesn't exist.

It can't. There are **two locks**, one before the AI and one after, and a recommendation has to pass both to reach a customer.

### Lock 1 — ask the shop first

**Before the AI is involved at all**, we ask the database a plain question: which items are genuinely in stock right now, for this business, that match what this customer asked about and fit their budget?

Whatever comes back is the shortlist — and **the AI is only ever shown this shortlist.** It cannot recommend something that isn't on it, because it is never shown anything else.

Then two gates decide whether there is anything to work with at all: does this business even have a catalogue yet, and did the shortlist come back with anything on it?

### The AI picks from the shortlist

**Ask Google's AI to choose two or three** and say why each suits this customer — OpenAI backing it up, both answers flattened into one shape, the call recorded with its exact tokens and cost.

**Then throw away anything that wasn't on the list.** Even though the AI was only shown real items, its answer is checked against the shortlist again and anything else is silently dropped.

Two enquiries stop in this column instead:

**No catalogue yet** → the enquiry parks and waits. Not an error — a business that hasn't finished setting up. It wakes up on its own once the catalogue arrives.

**A catalogue, but nothing suitable** → we record the honest reason, such as "the stated budget is below the cheapest item in stock". An honest no beats a convenient yes.

### Lock 2 — check the shop again, as we save

**Every chosen item is re-checked against live stock at the moment it is written down.** Time has passed since the shortlist was built and something may have sold out in between. Anything that no longer verifies is not saved.

**Did anything survive?** If so, write the next job ticket and call the workflow that drafts the reply.

If nothing survived, the enquiry does not go on to a customer reply — because there is nothing truthful left to offer.

## The promise these two locks keep

**Every product ever recommended was real and in stock. 39 out of 39. 100%.**

Lock 1 means the AI never sees a product that doesn't exist.
Lock 2 means even a correct-looking answer is re-checked against the shelf before it is saved.

When a customer asked for something that was out of stock, by name, the system didn't offer it. It said so.
